posts.title: Smashpad: A Toddler-Proof Notepad for Emacs
posts.description: A small Emacs minor mode that turns my editor into a fullscreen rainbow notepad for a toddler to bash - and locks everything else down, including C-x C-c.

posts.title: Building a Private Family Planner
posts.description: A small private website for our household - calendar, shopping, to-dos, meals, recipes and chores - built in a week with Claude Code and running on Azure's free tiers.

posts.title: Turning a Cheap Photo Frame into a Family Wall Display (Without Trusting It)
posts.description: A £50 Android photo frame shipped with root ADB, a setuid su and a vendor app that accepts remote root commands. How I cleaned it up, locked it to our family planner, and kept it off the home network.
